name: shake-pet
author: isaWLO
description: A transparent desktop and web shake-toy widget

extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Shake Pet analyzes system audio locally to animate your pictures.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Shake Pet can use microphone audio when system audio capture is unavailable.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Shake Pet needs screen capture permission only to access shared system audio.
